replayScope.sourceRef: https://docs.qwencloud.com/api-reference/chat/openai-chat and https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api-via-openai-chat-completions (read 2026-10-29): `preserve_thinking` "Specifies whether to append the `reasoning_content` from assistant messages in the conversation history to the model input"; "Currently supported by qwen3.8-max ..., qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.8-omni-flash ..., qwen3.7-max ..., qwen3.7-plus ..., qwen3.6-plus ..., qwen3.7-flash ..., qwen3.6-flash ..., kimi-k2.6 ..., kimi-k2.7-code ..."; enabling it "when historical messages lack `reasoning_content` does not cause an error". The Chat Completions adapter sends `preserve_thinking: true` for this row and replays `reasoning_content`; the same Model Studio reference (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api-via-openai-chat-completions), "Important (qwen3.8-max/qwen3.8-flash): When using qwen3.8-max/qwen3.8-flash, preserve_thinking defaults to true. You must send back all historical reasoning_content in the reasoning_content field."

continuationDomain.sourceRef: BOTH halves. Own-state acceptance: https://docs.qwencloud.com/api-reference/chat/openai-chat and https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api-via-openai-chat-completions (read 2026-10-29): `preserve_thinking` "Specifies whether to append the `reasoning_content` from assistant messages in the conversation history to the model input"; "Currently supported by qwen3.8-max ..., qwen3.8-flash, qwen3.8-omni-flash ..., qwen3.7-max ..., qwen3.7-plus ..., qwen3.6-plus ..., qwen3.7-flash ..., qwen3.6-flash ..., kimi-k2.6 ..., kimi-k2.7-code ..."; enabling it "when historical messages lack `reasoning_content` does not cause an error". The Chat Completions adapter sends `preserve_thinking: true` for this row and replays `reasoning_content`; the same Model Studio reference (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/qwen-api-via-openai-chat-completions), "Important (qwen3.8-max/qwen3.8-flash): When using qwen3.8-max/qwen3.8-flash, preserve_thinking defaults to true. You must send back all historical reasoning_content in the reasoning_content field." Why the domain is NARROW: the state is valid only for the model that produced it on this route -- a different model, or the same model at another provider (a different credential and account), never receives it, and the history renderer strips it there.
